title: Blue Book landing case with an alien footprint diagram

tellings.quote: the footprints of the alien was documented in a diagram by the first military officer on the scene

plain: Among the files of Project Blue Book, the US Air Force's UFO study of the 1950s and 60s, now kept at the National Archives, there is said to be a landing case where the first military officer to arrive drew a diagram of the alien's footprints. This comes from James Fox, a UFO investigator who says he went through the files himself. To Fox, it shows that the military took landings seriously enough to record the physical traces.
